# storage medium

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:storageMedium`](gmeow-storageMedium.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/storageMedium>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The medium of a storage location (a [`gmeow:StorageMedium`](../classes/gmeow-StorageMedium.md) individual). Functional: the medium is constitutive of the storage location (a different medium is a different store) — unlike the descriptive, multi-source [`gmeow:placeType`](gmeow-placeType.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:StorageLocation`](../classes/gmeow-StorageLocation.md) -> [`gmeow:StorageMedium`](../classes/gmeow-StorageMedium.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:storageMedium`](gmeow-storageMedium.md) from [`gmeow:StorageLocation`](../classes/gmeow-StorageLocation.md) to [`gmeow:StorageMedium`](../classes/gmeow-StorageMedium.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:StorageLocation`](../classes/gmeow-StorageLocation.md), [`gmeow:StorageMedium`](../classes/gmeow-StorageMedium.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the constitutive medium of a storage location; functional, because a different medium is a different store.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the descriptive, multi-source classification pattern (that is [`gmeow:placeType`](gmeow-placeType.md)) — a store has exactly one medium.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:StorageMedium`](../classes/gmeow-StorageMedium.md) individual; a change of medium is a different [`StorageLocation`](../classes/gmeow-StorageLocation.md), not a second value.
